task: Task 023.1: SEC Legibility vs Public Awareness Calibration

layered_resolution_framework.level_0: Economic Inception (binding contract execution / facility closing)
layered_resolution_framework.level_1: Public Headline Awareness (press release / news announcement of existence and size)
layered_resolution_framework.level_2: SEC/EDGAR Detailed Legal Legibility (filing of SPVs, advance rates, covenants on EDGAR)
layered_resolution_framework.level_3: Current Balance Measurability (quarter-end drawn debt reported in periodic 10-Q footnotes)
layered_resolution_framework.note: Level 1 is an illustrative framework supported by audited CoreWeave anchor cases (1-4 day awareness) rather than a systematic network-wide ledger.

ddtl_1_layered_timeline.level_1_public_headline_announcement: 2023-08-03 (Blackstone / Magnetar press release, 4-day lag: $2.3B facility announced)
ddtl_1_layered_timeline.level_2_sec_edgar_detailed_legibility: 2025-03-20 (Form S-1 / 10-Q exhibit filing, 599-day lag: CCAC II SPV, advance rates, covenants)
ddtl_1_layered_timeline.level_3_current_balance_measurability: 2026-06-30 balance of $1.300B reported in Form 10-Q on 2026-08-12
ddtl_1_layered_timeline.anchor_insight: Facility capacity of $2.3B was public within 4 days; contractual legibility lagged by 599 days; outstanding balance as of June 30, 2026 was $1.300B.

ddtl_2_layered_timeline.level_2_sec_edgar_detailed_legibility: 2025-03-20 (Form S-1 / 10-Q exhibit filing, 308-day lag: legal credit agreement capacity up to $7.6B)
ddtl_2_layered_timeline.level_3_current_balance_measurability: 2026-06-30 balance of $3.190B reported in Form 10-Q on 2026-08-12
ddtl_2_layered_timeline.anchor_insight: May 2024 press release announced $7.5B facility; subsequent SEC filings define the legal credit agreement capacity as up to $7.6B; outstanding balance as of June 30, 2026 was $3.190B.

summer_2026_pre_filing_debt_gap.context_and_resolution_boundary: The $18.934B residual represents all CoreWeave non-public-note principal ($13.643B DDTLs + $5.102B OEM + $0.189B Magnetar). Investors already possessed CoreWeave's Q1 Form 10-Q filed May 8, 2026 showing $25.149B total debt with itemized DDTL, OEM, and Magnetar balances as of March 31, 2026. Therefore, on July 1, 2026, this $18.934B was not previously unknown debt, but the maximum ceiling of liabilities whose June 30 current balance was not pinned down by the public-note baseline alone prior to the Q2 10-Q filing on Aug 12, 2026. The actual informational condition was balance staleness / unobservable Q2 draws, not nonexistent debt.

peak_committed_capacity_gap.insight: 15-month incubation period where up to $9.9B of credit capacity was active under bilateral agreements before Form S-1 disclosure.

march_2025_coreweave_topology.note: In the modeled graph, Blackstone and Magnetar are consolidated into BLACKSTONE_MAGNETAR_SYN, and OEM loans into OEM_FINANCING_PARTNERS.
